a.xlink:title: Shows the printing selector dock and updates it with the current card.
Returns the underlying CardInfoPtr.
Sets the current card for the selector and updates the display.
Updates the display by clearing the layout and loading new sets for the current card.
Sets every child widget's minimum size to the largest sizeHint in the layout.
Retrieves the count of items in the layout.
Returns the layout item at the specified index.
Removes all widgets from the flow layout and deletes them.
Loads and displays all sets for the current selected card.
Removes and returns the item at the specified index.
Adds a new item to the layout.
Reports which axis the layout can expand along.
Height-for-width is only meaningful for horizontal (wrapping) flow.
Returns the height required to display all items within width.
Places all children within rect.
Adds a widget to the flow layout within the FlowWidget.
Constructs an empty ExactCard.
Filters a list of card sets based on the search text.
Gets the underlying DeckListModel. You should generally refrain modifying the returned model directly...
Retrieves the current text in the search bar.
Gets the slider widget used for adjusting the card size.
Prepend card printings that are contained in the deck to the list of printings.
Constructs a PrintingSelectorCardDisplayWidget to display card information.
Sorts a list of card sets based on the selected sorting option.
Finds a card by name, zone, and optional identifiers.
Returns the printing information associated with this card.
Retrieves the value of a specific property.
Returns the set this printing belongs to.
Constructs a PrintingSelectorCardOverlayWidget for displaying a card overlay.
Creates and returns a new shared CardSet instance.
Returns the providerID for this printing.
